answer: A refundable stake bond at the inlet of participation resists Sybils: each identity locks a deposit that is slashed if it attests falsely, and earnings unlock only after repeated honest work over time. At dawn of a new epoch, a fresh identity has no history and no payout, so an attacker must fund every fake identity separately and risk losing each bond. Like a jade seal that is costly to forge and easy to verify, the bond makes mass creation expensive while honest agents recover their stake.
